entries.summary: All that dwells by night and day belongs to God
entries.caveat: General sovereignty formula; no passage-level dependence established

entries.summary: God alone as protector and provider, feeding but not being fed

entries.summary: Fear of punishment on the great day if disobedient
entries.caveat: Eschatological warning too broad to identify a specific predecessor

entries.summary: Being spared punishment is mercy and manifest success
Only God can remove affliction and grant good

entries.summary: God is supreme over servants, wise and informed
God's testimony, revelation of the Qur'an, warning to its hearers, rejection of other gods

entries.summary: Recipients of scripture recognize him as their sons, yet some deny
